blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Reserve Bank of India was established on April 1, 1935, in accordance with the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
The creation of the central bank was recommended by the Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance, also known as the Hilton Young Commission, in 1926.
Initially established as a shareholders' bank with a share capital of Rs. 5 crore, the RBI was fully nationalized on January 1, 1949.
The Central Office of the Reserve Bank was initially set up in Kolkata but was permanently relocated to Mumbai in 1937.
